name: @hydra/dsh-fleet
description: Prototype fleet plugin family for deepseek-harness (dsh): fleet-heartbeat (ctx.fleet registry + heartbeat/stall), fleet-mcp (stdio MCP server for any agent), fleet-inject (auto-expose fleet tools to agents), fleet-agent (profiles + signed events + agent config), fleet-bus (V3 event store + publish/subscribe/replay + followup/inject delivery), fleet-board (V3 transparency feed: CLI + HTTP + web page + fleet_feed), fleet-tasks (V3 flagship: shared task queue + org chart + heartbeat-wake claim + execution locks + artifact contracts), fleet-supervisor (V3 supervision: fleet-scheduler heartbeat-wake execution + takeover + orphan recovery + digests + ready-queue + silent-run watchdog + verification-gated merge queue), fleet-watchdog (V3 verification gate on stopped work: when every leaf of a watched task tree rests, verify the stop against evidence, reject false "done" — reopen + reassign), fleet-policy (V3 QM postures Strict/Auto/Dangerous + command policy hard denials: ctx.fleetPolicy.authorize refuses a denied action and publishes fleet/policy-denied with the rule + actor), fleet-budget (V3 cost tracking + scoped caps + soft warnings + escalation per owner decision #4: global/per-agent/per-task-kind budgets, fleet/budget-warning at the soft threshold and fleet/budget-escalated at the breach, with the checkWake(agentId) scheduler-consult seam). Issues #20, #26.
